resources.string: Shown while Conference Caddie looks for matching people nearby over Bluetooth.
A strong match is within a few metres.
Conference Caddie is finding people near you
Your phone broadcasts a random code and listens for others. Nothing about you is sent over Bluetooth.
Caddie needs the Nearby devices permission to broadcast a random code and to hear other phones that also turned this on. The code changes every 10 minutes and means nothing without our server.
On Android 11 and older, Android only lets an app scan for Bluetooth devices with the Location permission. Caddie never reads your position; it only listens for codes from other phones.
Notifications let Caddie tell you when a strong match is right near you, and show that it is listening.
